svg.title: Truncation: raise the cap and enlarge the domain
svg.desc: For f(x)=x+1 on [0,infinity), E_n=[0,n] and f_n=min(x+1,n) times the indicator of E_n. The first three curves increase at every fixed x as both the height cap and domain grow. Filled dots include x=n at height n; open circles exclude x=n from the zero segment.
